description: This file contains unit tests for error handling and other functionalities in Orleans-based grains, including tests for exception propagation, timing behavior, concurrency, grain references, and observer disconnection scenarios.

classes.name: ErrorGrainTest
classes.description: A suite of unit tests verifying the error handling, timing, concurrency, and other behaviors of Orleans grains in various error and asynchronous scenarios.

methods.name: ErrorGrain_GetGrain
methods.description: Verifies that error grain references can be obtained and basic method calls succeed.

methods.name: ErrorHandlingLocalError
methods.description: Tests local exception handling within grains, ensuring exceptions are properly caught and tasks faulted.

methods.name: ErrorHandlingGrainError1
methods.description: Ensures that exceptions thrown during grain method execution cause the returned Task to fault, and exceptions are correctly propagated.

methods.name: ErrorHandlingTimedMethod
methods.description: Tests that long-running grain tasks that do not throw errors complete successfully, with proper timing assertions.

methods.name: ErrorHandlingTimedMethodWithError
methods.description: Verifies that delayed grain methods which throw exceptions do so after the expected delay, and the failure is correctly propagated.

methods.name: StressHandlingMultipleDelayedRequests
methods.description: Stress tests the Orleans system by issuing multiple concurrent delayed grain calls and checks for successful completion.

methods.name: ArgumentTypes_ListOfGrainReferences
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of collections of grain references passed as method arguments.

methods.name: AC_DelayedExecutor_2
methods.description: Verifies Orleans' internal timer and scheduling by executing delayed grain operations and confirming correct completion.

methods.name: SimpleGrain_AsyncMethods
methods.description: Validates that grains correctly handle async methods for setting and retrieving state, demonstrating modern async/await patterns.

methods.name: SimpleGrain_PromiseForward
methods.description: Checks correct handling of chained grain calls where one call's result is forwarded to another.

methods.name: SimpleGrain_GuidDistribution
methods.description: Tests distribution and hashing behavior of grain IDs based on GUID patterns to ensure load balancing.

methods.name: ObserverTest_Disconnect
methods.description: Tests observer disconnection scenarios in Orleans event notification system.

methods.name: ObserverTest_Disconnect2
methods.description: Tests observer disconnection with multiple subscriptions, including edge case behaviors.
